products.note: AI avatar video; virtual presenters; enterprise video; likeness consent; Israeli vendor

reading.body:
Hour One is an Israeli vendor offering AI-generated avatar video, with products centered on virtual presenters, enterprise video, and likeness consent.

The product note signals that likeness consent is treated as a core feature rather than an afterthought. That framing matters because synthetic presenter video at scale requires managing rights for the human faces being replicated, and building that into the product suggests the offering is aimed at enterprises with legal exposure to worry about.

The data covers product category and vendor origin only. It says nothing about compute infrastructure, data center footprint, power consumption, or how the video generation workload is provisioned. No inferences about grid demand or scaling constraints are warranted from what is here.
